lessons.title: The Machine Learning Paradigm
lessons.description: Compare classical programming with machine learning, exploring Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning paradigms.

lessons.title: Data Preprocessing & Feature Engineering
lessons.description: Master data preparation essentials: handling missing values, encoding categorical variables, normalization, and standardization.

lessons.title: Linear Regression & Classification
lessons.description: Explore mathematical foundations: line fitting with Mean Squared Error (MSE) and binary classification with Logistic Regression.

lessons.title: Model Evaluation & Bias-Variance Tradeoff
lessons.description: Diagnose underfitting vs overfitting, use train/val/test splits, and master evaluation metrics like Precision, Recall, and F1-Score.
